notes: Oneironautics Inc., Portland OR (2005) · RESTORATION CAMPAIGN, set 2016. The studio's course-correct after Estuary 3's cult reception - and the strangest object in the classic run: a 2005 game set eleven years ahead, imagining a near future where somebody finally goes back and fixes the water. Ashford Cade's cabin note ('back in the spring · 2016') was always this game's door.

shelf.cover_blurb: It is 2016, and somebody has finally gone back for the water.  Read the archive, make your calls, and work the season — when the king tide comes, the estuary will tell you what your plan was worth.  From Oneironautics Inc.
shelf.prior_owner_note: Olaf's big box. The soft creases in the watershed map are his — he liked to fold it out on the kitchen table and check it against the real one.
